title: feat(cleanup): Periodically log progress
body:
Cleanup workers now emit a structured `cleanup.progress` INFO log with the model and last ID from a completed chunk. Each worker logs its first completed chunk for a model, then at most once every five minutes, leaving scan checkpoints even when a run ends before finishing.

A dedicated logger keeps these records visible while cleanup jobs use `--loglevel=ERROR`.
`last_id` is the last candidate ID in the completed chunk; it does not imply that the row was deleted.
